task.description: Diagnose GH #374: TC-TNT-02-03/04 observe exit 49 instead of linter exit codes. Search issue registry for prior art, register ISS file, determine root cause.
acceptance_criteria: ISS file registered with GitHub cross-reference

result.summary: Root cause: interpreter selection by bare name. argv[0]=="python" at tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig:612 and :680 can resolve to the WindowsApps App Execution Alias stub, which prints 'Python was not found...' and exits 49; the tests compare that against the linter's real exit codes 1 and 0. Reproduced directly on this machine: WindowsApps/python.exe on the linter -> exit 49. Which of the three PATH resolutions wins is not stable between an interactive shell and a zig-build-spawned test binary, so name-based selection cannot be made deterministic -- resolution must be probed. Prior art ISS-0138 (GH #440) fixed the sibling python3 case in build.zig by switching to "python"; that does not cover these call sites because they are in a test binary and because "python" carries the same alias.
